authorization: User requests same original E1 double-down subset, each stock max 1/60, recalculate monthly returns and excess
selection: Exactly reuse sealed original E1 Q5 double-down list and 70 original monthly dates; medium close[t-5]/close[t-60]-1<0 and short close[t]/close[t-5]-1<0
allocation: Each selected stock target1/60 of total account NAV including cash; residual cash; no search or refill with other stocks
cap_semantics: Enforce at scheduled monthly execution using post-fee NAV when sells possible; blocked legacy sells retained and disclosed; price drift allowed between scheduled trades, no added daily rebalancing
fee_consistency: Solve target scale q=post_fee_NAV/pretrade_NAV at same observed execution open; numerical fixed point <=40 steps tolerance1e-13; not economic optimization
benchmark: H00300 full return index close, monthly arithmetic excess in percentage points; cash materially lowers exposure so not risk-adjusted alpha
